verdict.rationale: Missive ships a real, runtime-verified MCP server (mcp.missiveapp.com) exposing conversations, contacts, drafts, and calendars scopes, and documents that Claude/ChatGPT can 'summarize your inbox' or 'triage new conversations' using this connection, which directly supports whole-inbox/calendar Q&A grounded in Missive data. However, missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that answers are accurate and non-hallucinated across a full inbox+calendar corpus, and explicit examples of calendar-specific Q&A rather than just conversation/CRM triage.
